name: Run SQL Query
description: Execute a SQL query in the SQL Workbench

steps.title: Navigate to SQL Workbench
steps.description: Click on 'SQL' in the left navigation menu, then select 'Workbench' to access the SQL editor. Live updates

steps.title: Select Database Connection
steps.description: Click the 'Select databases' button to choose which databases you want to work with. The button shows the number of currently selected databases.

steps.title: Write Your SQL Query
steps.description: Type or paste your SQL query in the editor. For example: SELECT * FROM SYSCAT.TABLES FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

steps.title: Execute the Query
steps.description: Click the 'Run All' (play icon ▶) to execute your SQL query.

steps.title: View Results
steps.description: The query results will appear in the results panel below the editor. You can view the data in table format, export results, or see execution statistics.
